scope:
Run an actual ordinary-user device watcher in one disposable Linux QEMU guest.

Only guest root changes the deliberately added QEMU keyboard and its driver.
No host USB passthrough, network NIC, helper, USB/IP service or device writes.

verification.scope: One disposable Linux guest, actual UID2000 CLI, actual kernel USB notifications and sysfs/driver changes; no USB/IP I/O or real-hardware qualification. No induced ENOBUFS, guaranteed transient capture or performance claim.
